title: The Midnight Library
author: Original
description: A magical journey through a library where books come alive.

paragraphs.text: Luna had always known there was something strange about the old library at the end of Maple Street. The building seemed to hum with an energy she couldn't explain.
One rainy evening, she stayed past closing time, hidden between the shelves. As the clock struck midnight, the books began to glow with a soft golden light.
A door appeared in the wall where there had been none before. It was made of ancient oak, carved with symbols of moons and stars. Luna reached for the handle.

artifact.caption: A key etched with tiny constellations, warm to the touch

paragraphs.text: Beyond the door lay a garden made entirely of words. Sentences grew like vines, and paragraphs bloomed like flowers. Characters from stories wandered the paths.
A fox wearing a tiny crown approached her. 'Welcome to the Midnight Library,' he said. 'Every story ever written lives here. Every story ever dreamed.'
Luna smiled. She had found a place where imagination was real, where stories breathed and danced. She knew she would return here, night after night.

artifact.caption: An inkblossom that unfurls into living sentences
